description: Header file defining the DecodedAudioQueue class, which manages a queue of DecodedAudio buffers for media playback, supporting operations like append, read, peek, and seek.

classes.name: DecodedAudioQueue
classes.description: A class that manages a queue of DecodedAudio buffers for media data, supporting reading, peeking, and seeking operations.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a DecodedAudio buffer to the queue.

methods.name: ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads a specified number of frames into a destination buffer, advancing the current position.

methods.name: PeekFrames
methods.description: Copies frames from the current position into a destination buffer without advancing the position.

methods.name: SeekFrames
methods.description: Moves the current position forward by a specified number of frames.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Returns the number of frames buffered beyond the current position.

methods.name: InternalRead
methods.description: Internal method to read frames, used by ReadFrames and SeekFrames.
